_note: One config per group (ARCHITECTURE §5). Slug `group_id` is load-bearing — it is the output path site/data/<group_id>/ and the URL. `display_name` is cosmetic.
_count_conference_championship_note: Per-group rule (ARCHITECTURE §1/§5): do conference-championship wins settle into a team's season win total? Sportsbooks differ, so it is per-group config, not a code constant. CFBD returns conf-title games as seasonType=regular; the shared cache tags them but excludes nothing — this flag decides. Default false.
_pick_rules_note: Settled format, enforced by validate_team_names.py per group: EXACTLY 4 picks per manager. Always enforced — no unenforced path. Conference spread is ADVISORY for this group and deliberately not gated: it was never agreed as a hard constraint in the family league and must not block a submitted board, so `min_distinct_conferences` is 1 (every roster trivially satisfies it). There is nothing to waive, so no `conference_minimum_waivers` list here — that mechanism is panel's.
_managers_note: Locked real identities; the roster is COMPLETE at 8 managers (the two anticipated additions landed, plus a third). Any further change is a config.json + picks edit, never a rebuild — every manager here needs a matching 4-pick set in picks.json or the §5 gate fails. `manager_id` is the stable join key everywhere — never displayed. `display_name` is cosmetic. `email` per manager (recipient list derives from these when email_enabled).
